app.output.help.default: Quality {quality} (default): more faithful than the older JPEG, for about the same size over the whole map (the sea and the edges much lighter). Up close, very colourful spots (flowers, thin markings) fade a little, as in any lossy WebP image.
app.output.help.higher: Above the default: a little more faithful, heavier files (95: a third more).
app.output.help.jpeg: JPEG and PNG: the older format (JPEG quality 82 for full tiles, PNG for the partly empty ones); the quality cannot be set.
app.output.help.lossless: Lossless: every pixel as it is drawn, fine colours included, but tiles about four times heavier (for archiving rather than publishing).
app.output.help.lower: Below the default: lighter files, but fine textures soften up close (85: the size of the older JPEG, still more faithful than it).
app.output.webpDetail: default · a single kind of file, transparency included, made for the web
